versions.changelog: Fix display name from test to QBO to Tax Bridge

Initial release: Bridge QBO data to IRS tax schedules and generate tax-ready workpapers.

- Map QBO chart of accounts and transactions to IRS forms (Schedule C, E, F, 1120S, 1120, 1065, and more)
- Generate trial balance exports and formatted tax workpapers
- Identify and flag transactions needing reclassification before filing
- Track and report crypto asset cost basis using FIFO, LIFO, HIFO, or Specific ID
- Provide detailed mapping reference tables for both income and expense categories
- Include workflow guidance for exporting QBO reports and mapping to entity-specific IRS schedules
